newsitem.title: USA: ABC Inc. names Roone Arledge chairman.
newsitem.headline: ABC Inc. names Roone Arledge chairman.

text.p: Television network ABC Inc. on Thursday elevated longtime ABC News President Roone Arledge to the newly created position of chairman.
Arledge, in turn, named David Westin president of ABC News. Westin has president of ABC's television network group since 1994.
ABC Inc. President Robert Iger said in a statement the appointments were part of a succession plan at ABC News.

"Roone's record in building this division speaks for itself, and his creativity and instinctive understanding of the medium of television are legendary in this business," Iger said. "Roone and David will be formidable team in guiding ABC News into the future."
